description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractEventStrategies' which serves as a superclass for managing a collection of event handling strategies. It provides mechanisms to add strategies and handle events by delegating them to the appropriate strategy based on event class type.

classes.name: AbstractEventStrategies
classes.description: Abstract superclass for managing event strategies, supporting addition and handling of event types, and logging when no strategy is found.

methods.name: addStrategy
methods.description: Adds an event handling strategy for a specific event class. Should be called only in constructors.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Delegates event handling to the appropriate strategy based on the event's class type. Logs an error if no strategy is found for the event.
